title: America’s public data has a trust problem
discussion_signal: The post reports low trust in information from federal agencies and frames public facts as a legitimacy infrastructure under strain. It links information credibility to whether people can orient themselves, judge policy, and trust public institutions.
linked_research_question: How does declining trust in public information affect policy judgment, civic participation, and institutional legitimacy?
limits: Research summary rather than full survey analysis
The post does not establish why trust declined or how it changes behavior
